read.passage: When Hessa joined her school's debating club, she was so shy that she could hardly speak in front of the class. Her teacher gave her one piece of advice: prepare a clear structure. Before every debate, Hessa wrote her position in one sentence, then listed three reasons, each with an example. She also prepared answers to the counter-arguments she expected. In hindsight, she says, that structure changed everything. 'If I hadn't learnt to organise my ideas, I would have given up after the first month,' she explains. Two years later, Hessa represented her region in a national competition. Although her team didn't win, she believes the experience was worth it. 'If I weren't so stubborn, I wouldn't have kept going,' she laughs. 'And now I'm not afraid of speaking to anyone.'

qs.q: What advice did Hessa's teacher give her?
qs.cando: Can understand articles that describe experiences and arguments.

read2.passage: When the town council proposed turning the main car park into a weekly night market, opinions were sharply divided. Shop owners feared that the stalls would take their customers, while residents complained about noise. Nevertheless, the council decided to run a three-month trial. The results surprised almost everyone. Local shops reported a twenty percent rise in sales on market nights, as visitors who came for the stalls also wandered into nearby stores. Although noise remained a concern, the council introduced a ten o'clock closing time, which most residents accepted. Had the trial not taken place, the town might have lost one of its most popular events. The market now opens every Thursday.

qs.q: Why were shop owners worried at first?
options: They thought the car park would close.
They thought the stalls would take their customers.
They wanted stalls of their own.
qs.cando: Can understand articles that describe experiences and arguments.

qs.cando: Can understand articles that describe experiences and arguments.

qs.q: How did the council deal with the noise?
qs.cando: Can understand articles that describe experiences and arguments.
